# jamfpro_v1_log_flushing_task (Resource)

Get log flushing task.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Code generated by tfpfgen. DO NOT EDIT.

resource "jamfpro_v1_log_flushing_task" "example" {
  qualifier             = "tfacc-qualifier"
  retention_period      = 1
  retention_period_unit = "tfacc-retention-period-unit"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `qualifier` (String) The qualifier of the retention policy
- `retention_period` (Number) The period beyond which data will be flushed
- `retention_period_unit` (String) The unit of the retention period (eg: DAY, WEEK, MONTH, YEAR)

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the log flushing task
- `state` (String) The state of the task (eg: RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED, CANCELLED)
